Train high-quality custom machine learning models with minimal machine
learning expertise and effort.

## Overview

The following types provide methods to make RPCs. They are a good starting point
to learn about this library.

- `DataFoundryServiceClient`: Service for generating and preparing datasets for Gen AI evaluation. (enabled by the `DataFoundryService` trait)
- `DatasetServiceClient`: The service that manages Vertex AI Dataset and its child resources. (enabled by the `DatasetService` trait)
- `DeploymentResourcePoolServiceClient`: A service that manages the DeploymentResourcePool resource. (enabled by the `DeploymentResourcePoolService` trait)
- `EndpointServiceClient`: A service for managing Vertex AI's Endpoints. (enabled by the `EndpointService` trait)
- `EvaluationServiceClient`: Vertex AI Online Evaluation Service. (enabled by the `EvaluationService` trait)
- `FeatureOnlineStoreAdminServiceClient`: The service that handles CRUD and List for resources for FeatureOnlineStore. (enabled by the `FeatureOnlineStoreAdminService` trait)
- `FeatureOnlineStoreServiceClient`: A service for fetching feature values from the online store. (enabled by the `FeatureOnlineStoreService` trait)
- `FeatureRegistryServiceClient`: The service that handles CRUD and List for resources for FeatureRegistry. (enabled by the `FeatureRegistryService` trait)
- `FeaturestoreOnlineServingServiceClient`: A service for serving online feature values. (enabled by the `FeaturestoreOnlineServingService` trait)
- `FeaturestoreServiceClient`: The service that handles CRUD and List for resources for Featurestore. (enabled by the `FeaturestoreService` trait)
- `GenAiCacheServiceClient`: Service for managing Vertex AI's CachedContent resource. (enabled by the `GenAiCacheService` trait)
- `GenAiTuningServiceClient`: A service for creating and managing GenAI Tuning Jobs. (enabled by the `GenAiTuningService` trait)
- `IndexEndpointServiceClient`: A service for managing Vertex AI's IndexEndpoints. (enabled by the `IndexEndpointService` trait)
- `IndexServiceClient`: A service for creating and managing Vertex AI's Index resources. (enabled by the `IndexService` trait)
- `JobServiceClient`: A service for creating and managing Vertex AI's jobs. (enabled by the `JobService` trait)
- `LlmUtilityServiceClient`: Service for LLM related utility functions. (enabled by the `LlmUtilityService` trait)
- `MatchServiceClient`: MatchService is a Google managed service for efficient vector similarity search at scale. (enabled by the `MatchService` trait)
- `MetadataServiceClient`: Service for reading and writing metadata entries. (enabled by the `MetadataService` trait)
- `MigrationServiceClient`: A service that migrates resources from automl.googleapis.com, datalabeling.googleapis.com and ml.googleapis.com to Vertex AI. (enabled by the `MigrationService` trait)
- `ModelGardenServiceClient`: The interface of Model Garden Service. (enabled by the `ModelGardenService` trait)
- `ModelServiceClient`: A service for managing Vertex AI's machine learning Models. (enabled by the `ModelService` trait)
- `NotebookServiceClient`: The interface for Vertex Notebook service (a.k.a. (enabled by the `NotebookService` trait)
- `PersistentResourceServiceClient`: A service for managing Vertex AI's machine learning PersistentResource. (enabled by the `PersistentResourceService` trait)
- `PipelineServiceClient`: A service for creating and managing Vertex AI's pipelines. (enabled by the `PipelineService` trait)
- `PredictionServiceClient`: A service for online predictions and explanations. (enabled by the `PredictionService` trait)
- `ReasoningEngineExecutionServiceClient`: A service for executing queries on Reasoning Engine. (enabled by the `ReasoningEngineExecutionService` trait)
- `ReasoningEngineServiceClient`: A service for managing Vertex AI's Reasoning Engines. (enabled by the `ReasoningEngineService` trait)
- `ScheduleServiceClient`: A service for creating and managing Vertex AI's Schedule resources to periodically launch shceudled runs to make API calls. (enabled by the `ScheduleService` trait)
- `SessionServiceClient`: The service that manages Vertex Session related resources. (enabled by the `SessionService` trait)
- `SpecialistPoolServiceClient`: A service for creating and managing Customer SpecialistPools. (enabled by the `SpecialistPoolService` trait)
- `TensorboardServiceClient`: TensorboardService. (enabled by the `TensorboardService` trait)
- `VertexRagDataServiceClient`: A service for managing user data for RAG. (enabled by the `VertexRagDataService` trait)
- `VertexRagServiceClient`: A service for retrieving relevant contexts. (enabled by the `VertexRagService` trait)
- `VizierServiceClient`: Vertex AI Vizier API. (enabled by the `VizierService` trait)

import GoogleIAMV1

func sample() async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudAIPlatformV1.PredictionServiceClient()
  let response = try await client.predict(
    request: PredictRequest()
  /* set fields using .with { $0... } */
)
  print("Success: \(response)")
}

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-aiplatform-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-aiplatform-v1.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudAIPlatformV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudAIPlatformV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-aiplatform-v1
```

### Package Traits

This package uses Swift package traits to conditionally compile individual service
clients and their associated types. Enabling a trait enables the corresponding
client and all the request, response, and model types needed to use that client.

The following traits are enabled by default:
- `PredictionService`

To enable additional traits alongside the defaults, specify them in `Package.swift`:

```swift
.package(url: "https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-aiplatform-v1.git", from: "0.3.0", traits: [".defaults", "<TraitName>"])
```

| Trait | Default | Enabled Client |

| `DataFoundryService` | No | `DataFoundryServiceClient` |
| `DatasetService` | No | `DatasetServiceClient` |
